pack.title: Moochers & money asks
pack.description: The friend with an empty wallet and perfect timing. Keep the friend, keep the money.

scenarios.setting: Group dinner. The check lands; your friend suddenly studies the ceiling.
scenarios.jab: Just put it on your card — I'll get you back, I swear.

replies.line: Let's split it now. Cleaner for everyone.
replies.why: It makes settling up the group's norm, so no one is singled out.

replies.line: Your share is forty. Venmo me.
replies.why: A number plus a method turns a favor into a transaction with no drama.

replies.line: I'll cover you tonight — send it before we're home though.
replies.why: Generosity with a same-night deadline keeps the friendship and the ledger clean.

replies.line: My card's retired from lending. It unionized.
replies.why: Blaming your card lets the table laugh while the point lands on him.

trap.line: You ALWAYS do this. Pay your own way for once.
trap.why: A public callout collects the forty dollars and loses the friend.

scenarios.setting: Phone call. A friend you like owes you two hundred from spring.
scenarios.jab: Hey man, can you float me another hundred till Friday?

replies.line: Let's clear spring first. Then we'll talk.
replies.why: It links the new ask to the old debt, which is the only honest order.
No plus the number keeps it business, not personal.

replies.line: I'm tapped out on loans this year — want help budgeting instead?
replies.why: It closes the wallet while opening a door, so the friendship has somewhere to go.
